cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: The substrate must be secure, ready to take loads as well as free of oil, grease, dust and other separating layers.

A primer is recommended prior to application, refer the the specific instructions on the relevant product data sheet of the Sika waterproofing membrane. Priming of PVC control leak flanges and metal channel drains are not required. Apply the Sika® SealTape B directly onto the surface and use a small roller flatten and avoid air pockets.

cl.x: Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (December 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.

s: Thickness: ~ 0.99 mm

cl.c: Data sheet pages 2-3: Application Instructions > Application Method / Tools
s: Remove the Sika® SealTape B protective foil liner and stick to the dust-free substrate by applying pressure without prestressing. Immediately after this, the waterproofing compound. The tape must be incorporated into the waterproofing layer with the correct layer thickness. At splices and connection points, the tape must overlap by at least 4 cm.
The middle of the Sika® SealTape B requires no overcoating with the waterproofing membrane. The waterproofing membrane shall be applied to a minimum width of 25mm over the tape edges.

Internal, external corners, and pipe penetrations can be cut out of the Sika® SealTape B. Refer to the method statement located on the Sika Australia website. If Sika® SealTape B is bonded on top of the waterproofing layer, it must be overlayed with a coat of the selected waterproofing membrane.
For sealing around pipes, drains and in corners, the tape must be cut to size accordingly.
Not suitable for pressurised water such as pools and spas use SikaSeal Tape F for these applications.
Use in conjunction with the relevant product data sheet for the selected Sika waterproofing membrane.
For uses not mentioned in this document contact SIka Australia.
